description: MatFlow audit/loop-fixes-01: Bug 4 + Bug 3 + Feature 8 + Playwright coverage

stories.title: Bug 4 — Class creation: validation toast + API error surfacing
acceptanceCriteria: ClassForm.submit() calls showToast when any schedule entry has an empty startTime or endTime — requires useToast to be called inside ClassForm
Clicking Create with an empty schedule start time shows a toast containing 'Start and end time are required' and does NOT call the API
handleSave() in TimetableManager: when API returns !res.ok, reads response JSON and surfaces body.error in the toast (falls back to generic message if body cannot be parsed)
TypeScript compiles without errors on components/dashboard/TimetableManager.tsx

stories.title: Bug 3 — Vercel Blob: switch to private access + signed-URL proxy
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/upload/route.ts uses access: 'private' (not 'public') in the put() call
app/api/blob-image/route.ts exists and requires requireSession() auth — unauthenticated requests receive 401
app/api/blob-image/route.ts accepts ?path= query param, returns a 302 redirect to the Blob download URL for that path
All usages of blob-stored URLs (profile pictures in Avatar/MemberProfile) go via /api/blob-image?path= not direct blob URLs
TypeScript compiles without errors on all changed files

stories.title: Feature 8 — Parent/guardian waiver separate from adult waiver
acceptanceCriteria: prisma/schema.prisma Tenant model has kidsWaiverTitle String? and kidsWaiverContent String? fields
A Prisma migration named add_kids_waiver_fields has been applied successfully
lib/default-waiver.ts exports buildDefaultKidsWaiverTitle() and buildDefaultKidsWaiverContent(gymName) functions
app/api/settings/route.ts Zod schema accepts kidsWaiverTitle and kidsWaiverContent, and PATCH saves them to the Tenant
components/dashboard/SettingsPage.tsx shows a 'Parent/Guardian Waiver' section on the waiver tab with title + content editor
app/api/waiver/sign-for-child/route.ts uses kidsWaiverTitle/kidsWaiverContent (with new default fallbacks) not the adult waiver fields
components/member/KidPhotosAndWaiver.tsx accepts kidsWaiverTitle and kidsWaiverContent props and renders the waiver text before the sign button
TypeScript compiles without errors on all changed files

stories.title: Playwright — coverage for fixed features
acceptanceCriteria: tests/e2e/dashboard/settings-checkin-window.spec.ts exists and tests: navigates to settings waiver tab, types 300 into before-input, verifies value is clamped to 180

tests/e2e/dashboard/timetable-class-create.spec.ts exists and tests: opens new class drawer, attempts create with class name but empty schedule start time, verifies a toast with 'required' or 'start time' appears
tests/e2e/dashboard/settings-waiver.spec.ts exists and tests: waiver tab shows both 'Liability Waiver' and 'Parent/Guardian Waiver' sections
All 3 new spec files pass with npx playwright test --project=chromium on the 3 new files specifically

stories.title: Build + lint clean
acceptanceCriteria: npm run lint exits 0 with no errors
npm run build exits 0 with no errors
